_doc: Ratchet for scripts/check-axe.mjs. Each entry allows N serious/critical nodes for one axe rule on one surface run; anything above N fails, anything below is printed as 'improved' so the entry can be tightened.

`color-contrast` entries are Task 27 debt: the wiki light `h2 small` (#B86A00 on #FFFFFF, 4.12:1) and the wiki dark `a.eng` (white on #5CC4D0, 2.05:1) nodes measured in design-system/audit/2026-11-24/accessibility.md D-18. They are known WCAG 1.4.3 failures, not passes.
Any other rule appearing here must name a real owner and reason. Empty surfaces are listed explicitly so a new violation on a clean surface fails loudly.

color-contrast.reason: `h2 small` amber #B86A00 on #FFFFFF = 4.11:1; needs a darker small-size amber token or >=18.66px bold
`a.eng` white on #5CC4D0 = 2.04:1; the label must use the on-accent token, not primitive white
